CoreExtensions_Config_RecentFilesDirecto: The Recent Files tab shows the most recently modified files under these, merged into one list (subdirectories included).
CoreExtensions_Config_RecentFilesCountLa: Maximum number of files to show
CoreExtensions_Config_RecentFilesMaxAgeD: Only files modified within this many minutes are shown. 0 for no age limit.
WebUrl_OpenHint: Enter or click to open in your browser
Action_AddFavorite_Desc: Adds the selected file or folder to Favorites.
Calculator_CopyResult: Enter or click to copy result
Calculator_DescSuffix: - Enter or click to copy result
Calculator_FullResultDesc: Scientific Calculator - Enter or click to copy result to clipboard
Command_AdminDesc: Opens an elevated Command Prompt window and runs this command
Command_NormalDesc: Opens a Command Prompt window and runs this command
QuickLook_Inaccessible: Item does not exist or is inaccessible.
QuickLook_DragHint: Drag to copy this file elsewhere
Action_Open_Desc: Opens the selected file or folder using the default associated application.
Action_OpenAdmin_Desc: Runs the selected executable with administrative / elevated privileges.
Action_LocateFolder_Desc: Opens the parent folder in Windows File Explorer and highlights the selected item.
Action_CopyName_Desc: Copies the names of the selected files or folders to the clipboard.
Action_CopyPath_Desc: Copies the full physical path of the selected item to the clipboard.
Action_Copy_Desc: Copies the selected file to the system clipboard for pasting in Explorer.
Action_Cut_Desc: Cuts the selected file to the system clipboard for pasting in Explorer.
Action_Paste_Desc: Pastes the files on the clipboard into the selected folder (or its parent folder, if a file is selected), copying or moving depending on whether they were copied or cut.
Action_Delete_Desc: Moves the selected file to the Recycle Bin, with the same confirmation prompt Explorer shows.
Action_PermanentDelete_Desc: Permanently deletes the selected file, bypassing the Recycle Bin, with the same confirmation prompt Explorer shows.
Action_OpenCmd_Desc: Opens a Command Prompt window inside the selected folder or file's parent directory.
Action_OpenAdminCmd_Desc: Opens an elevated Command Prompt window inside the selected folder.
Action_Touch_Desc: Creates a new empty file in the selected directory.
Action_Mkdir_Desc: Creates a new folder in the selected directory.
Plugin_ShellGroup_Desc: Displays the standard Windows context menu in the right-click menu.
CoreExtensions_PluginDesc: Core extensions plugin. Provides rich file context actions (like run as admin, copy path, create file/folder, open CMD, etc.) as well as system thumbnail providers and custom shortcut folder indexing.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_FolderPreviewProvider: Displays a quick list of the first 30 file items in a folder in the right preview panel.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_ImagePreviewProvider: Displays thumbnail and full-aspect preview images in the right preview panel.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_TextPreviewProvider: Renders up to the first 1000 lines of text files as read-only text in the preview panel.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_PePreviewProvider: Reads and parses executable headers (x86/x64 architecture, compile time, etc.) in the preview panel.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_DefaultMetadataPreviewP: Displays basic file attributes and detailed metadata in the right panel as a fallback preview.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_ShellPreviewHandlerProv: Calls Windows Preview Handlers to render interactive PDF, Office documents, and rich text in the panel.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_WebUrlInstantProvider: Generates a direct open option in search results when a URL (http/https) is typed in the search box.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_TypeFilterProvider: Adds a file type filter panel to the search sidebar, supporting quick filtering by categories like folders, files, documents, images, and videos.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_StartMenuAppItemProvide: Scans and indexes Windows Start Menu and desktop shortcuts to provide application search entries.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_SortFilterQueryTokenPro: Parses extension filters starting with a dot (e.g. .png) and sorting modifiers (e.g. S, -M for size or date ascending/descending) to filter and sort search results.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_ShellThumbnailProvider: Uses Windows Shell APIs to extract native high-definition image thumbnails for search items.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_PathExclusionQueryToken: Parses path filter modifiers starting with a colon (e.g. :pattern) to keep only search results whose path segments match the pattern.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_HistoryTabProvider: Displays a user's recent search and access history tab when the search box is empty.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_FileSizeFilterProvider: Adds a file size filter panel to the search sidebar, supporting quick filtering by small, medium, and huge size ranges.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_FileSizeColumnProvider: Provides file size values and custom column rendering for the search results grid.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_FavoritesTabProvider: Shows a tab of directories and file shortcuts manually favorited by the user when the search bar is empty.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_ExplorerPathCollector: Automatically queries the active directory path from the foreground Windows Explorer window.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_EnvironmentVariableInst: Resolves system environment variables (e.g., %TEMP%) in real-time to generate open action items.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_DateModifiedFilterProvi: Adds a date modified filter panel to the search sidebar, supporting quick filtering by ranges like last 24 hours, last 7 days, etc.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CoreTranslationProvider: Provides localization and UI translation resources for the core assembly and basic extensions.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CoreThemeProvider: Provides core visual styling themes (including Dark, Light, and high-contrast system styles).
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CommandInstantProvider: Enables running commands directly in Command Prompt from the search box when prefixed with a trigger ($ for normal, # for administrator).
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CalculatorInstantProvid: Calculates mathematical expressions in real-time and displays results in the search results.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_SearchSettingsInstantPr: Type "set " followed by a keyword to fuzzy-match a specific setting, then jump straight to it (with a highlight) in the Settings window.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_ExplorerInlineSearchAda: Provides instant inline type-to-find pinyin/fuzzy jumping inside active Windows Explorer windows.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_StandardFileDialogAdapt: Enables the directory quick-jump adapter inside modern Windows open/save file dialogs.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_FolderBrowserDialogAdap: Enables folder jump capabilities inside standard directory selection dialogs.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_ClassicFileDialogAdapte: Enables fast path input and redirection inside legacy Windows open/save file dialogs.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_TouchAction: Quickly creates a new empty file in the selected directory.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_MkdirAction: Quickly creates a new subfolder in the selected directory.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_LocateInExplorerAction: Opens and highlights the selected file or folder in Windows Explorer.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_OpenCommandPromptAction: Opens a standard Command Prompt (CMD) window at the selected item's directory.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_OpenAdminCommandPromptA: Opens an elevated Command Prompt (CMD) window as administrator at the selected path.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_OpenResultAction: Opens the selected file, application, or directory using the default system handler.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_OpenResultAsAdminAction: Runs the selected executable program or opens the file with administrator privileges.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CopyNameAction: Copies the names of the selected files or folders to the system clipboard.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CopyPathAction: Copies the full file path of the selected file or folder to the system clipboard.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CopyFileAction: Copies the selected file or folder to the clipboard for pasting elsewhere.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CutFileAction: Cuts the selected file or folder to the clipboard for moving elsewhere.
Plugins_Comp_ShellMenuActionProvider: Windows File Explorer Shortcut Menu Support
Plugins_Comp_FileSizeColumnProvider: File Size and Type Result Columns
Plugins_Alias_PinyinAliasProvider: Chinese Pinyin & Initials Search Alias Extension
CoreExtensions_Config_ThumbnailExtension: List of extensions to extract thumbnails for, one per line (starts with '.', e.g. .jpg)
CoreExtensions_Config_CustomFoldersDesc: One folder path per line. Shortcuts and apps inside will appear in search results.
CoreExtensions_Config_SearchSettingsTrig: Type this word followed by a space (e.g. "set ") in the search box to fuzzy-search and jump to a specific setting.
CoreExtensions_Config_InlineSearchAlways: Open items directly instead of navigating
When enabled, selecting items in the Explorer inline search window will open files directly or open folders in a new window instead of navigating the active Explorer window.
CoreExtensions_Config_CustomFiltersDesc: Use :@<keyword> in the search box to apply custom filter rules (e.g. :@doc for documents).
CoreExtensions_Config_CustomFilters_Keyw: Prefix with :@ in search to apply this filter rule (e.g. type doc to use :@doc).
CoreExtensions_Config_CustomFilters_Rule: Supports file extensions or wildcard rules (e.g. *.doc; *.pdf or doc,docx,pdf), separated by semicolon or comma.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CustomFilterQueryTokenP: Parses custom filter tokens starting with :@ and filters search results based on wildcard or extension rules.
CoreExtensions_Config_PathExclusionPrefi: Prefix character for path fuzzy-matching tokens (default :).
CoreExtensions_Config_CustomFilterPrefix: Prefix character for custom filter tokens (default @).
CoreExtensions_Config_WildcardFilterPref: Prefix character to trigger wildcard secondary filtering (default ?).
